text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon skips our first day of training for the Champions Cup. Instead, I find her by the river.
Smart Falcon's worries are laid bare. Caught up in aiming for the top, she no longer enjoys the act of performing, so I ask her to sing something on the spot.
Our little concert helps Smart Falcon remember her initial resolution—her original dream to simply shine.
I reassure her that she's never truly lost that shine. With newfound confidence, she looks ahead to her next race.
